prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: authored 2D game sprite sheet. Reference image identity: cute glossy golden apricot GARDEN SLUG, long tapering curved tail on LEFT, large soft round head on RIGHT, amber orange patches,cream highlights,pink cheek blush,small playful mouth with pink tongue. Exactly TWO brown eyes in cream eyeballs ON TOP OF TWO TALL EYESTALKS. NO eyes/brows on face/body; face below stalks only cheeks and mouth. No shell,feet,arms,extra feelers. Same warm painted shading/dark outline,front threequarter facingRIGHT,NEVER mirror. FOUR SMALL complete slugs in strict2rows2columns at centers25/75percent; entire silhouette max30percent canvaswidth and32percent canvasheight including eyestalks/tail. Large EMPTY transparent centralcross andoutermargin, full stalks/tail enclosed eachcell. True alpha transparency; NO groundshadow/slime puddle/background/haze/speedmarks/FX/text/grid/extracharacters. Authored anatomy articulation rather than scaled copies. Four idle/blink poses:1 both upper eyes open,tailresting;2 eyestalks gently angle and mouth settles,eyesopen;3 opaque golden eyelids halfcover BOTH upper eyes with cream and brown pupils stillvisible in BOTH;4 BOTH upper eyes completely concealed by opaque golden lids,short closed seams,no cream,pupil or eye highlights visible. Keep eyestalks attached and no new face eyes.
